label: DR-012
note: Navigation-property access inside an EF Core .Select()/.Where() lambda is an expression tree translated to SQL (LEFT JOIN with NULL propagation), not runtime C#. Reviewer must NOT flag NRE or suggest ?. on navigation properties inside the IQueryable projection.

known_false_positive.title: Possible NullReferenceException on v.Charterer.Company.Name
known_false_positive.why_it_matters: Charterer and Company are optional navigations; when either is null this projection throws and the voyage list endpoint returns 500. Use null-conditional access on the navigation chain.
